## What is interpretations 1

::: {style="font-size: 0.58em;"}

| scenario | \(R\): sustain | \(D/G\): natural processes | \(E\): intervention | time scales |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| forest | timber stock | regrowth / harvest, disturbance | harvest limits, replanting, forestry policy | years vs decades |
| software | usability | ecosystem drift, bit rot / reuse, community repair | maintenance, testing, documentation, funding | days-weeks vs years |
| methods | methodological capability | obsolescence, rising complexity / innovation, transfer | research effort, benchmarking, education | project cycles vs decades |
| computing | effective compute | demand growth / hardware and algorithmic gains | scheduling, adaptivity, model reduction | jobs-hours vs years |
| humans | scientific capability | turnover, skill decay / learning, mentoring | training, mentoring, protected learning time | deadlines vs careers |

:::
